text: you are going to make a moped. here is an example image [Image #1]; the target poly count is ~2200 polygons, and you will want to correctly partition your final mesh. You will want a gas tank, a kick stand, and all the fixtures. if you need to collect more reference images, you can freely use the image generator from the /agent-skin skill without a uv and with or without a reference image.  this will let you get exact images like a specific angles if needed. There is no rush, so take your time to do so properly.
resolution: Built a 1.84 x 0.70 x 1.20 m retro step-through moped in the live studio editor as package Moped_50 (cart/editor/data/models/props/Moped_50), 2046 render triangles against the ~2200 target. Proportions were derived from four gpt-image-2 reference elevations generated through cart/editor/img.cjs (side/front/rear/low-rear) and measured against a 1.28 m wheelbase: 0.43 m wheels, 0.775 m seat, 0.32 m floorboard, 0.98 m bar height. The mesh is partitioned into 78 named Outliner parts inside 9 groups (Wheels, Front End, Controls, Lighting, Bodywork, Seat and Rack, Powertrain, Stands, Trim) and every face carries an authored semantic region name, including the requested gas tank with filler cap, a deployed side kickstand with bracket and foot plate, a folded centre stand, engine/belt case/exhaust, mirrors, indicators, grab rail, mudflap and chrome trim. Shape work used region tapers plus loop cuts with box-band selection under temporary part hiding, and both fenders are solidified partial-cylinder shells. Save reports status healthy with saved/mount/resident all 2046/2046 faces and 0 unnamed; the package is gitignored so nothing was committed.
